meta.purpose: Validation of the UbiMap suitability model against PSA production statistics for Ubi [Greater yam]
meta.psa_source: Philippine Statistics Authority OpenSTAT, crops production tables 0082E4EVCP3.px (volume) and 0112E4EAHM3.px (area), 2025 annual
meta.note: One row per sampled point inside each province. The engine scores every point, then the province score is the mean.
meta.slope_source: NASA SRTM 30 m via opentopodata srtm30m, five point gradient over about 555 m
meta.imerg_rainfall_note: Province level GPM IMERG monthly climatology applied to each point of that province. 85 of 110 points received it. Provinces with no IMERG province level data: Apayao, Basilan, Dinagat, Sorsogon, Surigao del Norte.
